第12章 拖延时间-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安把电动车停在路边，从后备箱翻出一件蓝色的闪送马甲套在短袖外面。

有先见之明，这两天在某东上网购的，现在派上用场了。

整理了一下衣领，他走向卓越世纪中心的大堂。

安保确实严。前台保安查验了闪送APP里的订单详情，又让他出示身份证登记，最后才递过来一张临时的电梯控制卡片。

“只能去29楼，送完马上下来，别乱跑。”保安面无表情的警告了一句。

“懂的懂的。”顾承安脸上没有变化，心里却早就m＊＊＊。

刷卡进闸机，电梯直达29楼。

走出轿厢，走廊里铺着厚厚的地毯，脚步声被完全吸收。顾承安顺着门牌号一路找过去，停在2908号门前。

看了眼门头，没错，就是这里。

推开一扇沉重的暗色胡桃木双开门。门口右上角，一个黑色半圆形摄像头正对着走廊。

顾承安面色如常，抬手按响门铃。

等了大概十秒，门开了。

一个穿着职业装、化着精致淡妆的年轻女人站在门后，上下打量了他一眼，目光落在他的蓝色马甲上。

“闪送？”女人问。

“对，我来取件，尾号6018。”顾承安拿出手机核对。这女人应该就是官网上写的那个行政兼财务，刘小曼。

“进来吧，等一下。”刘小曼侧过身。

顾承安迈步走进去。

门在身后关上，隔绝了走廊的冷气。

入眼是一个宽敞的前台区域，装修简单。没有常见的公司文化墙，只有一整面落地窗，能俯瞰大半个福田CBD。

顾承安目光快速扫过全场。

前台左侧是办公区，只有三个工位。右侧是一组真皮沙发。

沙发上坐着两个男人。

穿着黑色的休闲西装，寸头，体格健硕。两人原本在看手机，顾承安进门的瞬间，两人的目光几乎同时看了过来。

眼神锐利，带着审视。

这两人他见过，就是天珠app里面他留意到的那两人。

顾承安站在前台边，身体微微佝偻，双手交叠放在身前，一副拘谨的打工人模样。

刘小曼走进里面的独立办公室拿文件。

沙发上的两个男人没动，但顾承安能感觉到，他们的注意力完全锁定在自己身上。

Gu Chengan parked his electric car on the side of the road and took out a blue flash vest from the trunk and put it on over his short sleeves.

I had the foresight to buy something online in the past two days, and now it comes in handy.

After adjusting his collar, he walked towards the lobby of Century Center of Excellence.

Security is really tight.The security guard at the front desk checked the order details in the Shanshuo APP, asked him to show his ID card to register, and finally handed him a temporary elevator control card.

"You can only go to the 29th floor. Come down immediately after delivery and don't run around." The security guard warned expressionlessly.

"I understand, I understand." Gu Chengan's face did not change, but his heart was already m****.

Swipe your card to enter the turnstile and the elevator goes directly to the 29th floor.

After stepping out of the car, the corridor was covered with thick carpets, and the sound of footsteps was completely absorbed.Gu Chengan followed the house number and stopped in front of door No. 2908.

I glanced at the door, yes, this is it.

A heavy dark walnut double door opened.In the upper right corner of the door, a black semicircular camera is facing the corridor.

Gu Chengan's expression remained normal and he raised his hand to ring the doorbell.

After waiting for about ten seconds, the door opened.

A young woman wearing business attire and delicate makeup stood behind the door, looking him up and down, and her eyes fell on his blue vest.

"Flash delivery?" the woman asked.

"Yes, I'll pick it up. The tail number is 6018." Gu Chengan took out his mobile phone to check.This woman should be the administrative and financial person listed on the official website, Liu Xiaoman.

"Come in, wait a moment." Liu Xiaoman turned sideways.

Gu Chengan stepped inside.

The door closed behind him, cutting off the air-conditioning in the corridor.

The first thing you see is a spacious front desk area with simple decoration.There is no common company culture wall, only a whole wall of floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking most of Futian CBD.

Gu Chengan's eyes quickly scanned the entire audience.

To the left of the front desk is the office area, with only three workstations.On the right is a set of leather sofas.

Two men were sitting on the sofa.

Wearing a black casual suit, he has a short haircut and a strong build.The two of them were looking at their phones. The moment Gu Chengan entered the door, their eyes looked over almost at the same time.

His eyes were sharp and scrutinizing.

He had seen these two people before, they were the two people he noticed in the Tianzhu app.

Gu Chengan stood at the front desk, his body slightly stooped, his hands folded in front of him, looking like a cautious working man.

Liu Xiaoman walked into the independent office inside to get documents.

The two men on the sofa didn't move, but Gu Chengan could feel that their attention was completely focused on him.
